acceptance_predicates.description: Every SQLite coordination write reads and validates the durable upgrade barrier under the prescribed lock order before opening its authority transaction.
Held, releasing, ambiguous, stale, and missing control state reject without changing the SQLite authority or projections.
Independent-process and process-death tests prove durable safe-mode behavior and recovery only after independently verified release.

definition_of_done: The route inventory identifies every SQLite coordination write and each route is either fenced or explicitly read-only.
Hostile multi-process tests cover lock order, barrier state drift, control-store swaps, transaction timing, and process death.
Independent review and hosted checks pass at one exact product revision; public upgrade mutation remains rejection-only.

inputs.description: Existing SQLite mutation route and control-store evidence.

outputs.description: A bounded, independently reviewed SQLite coordination-write fence seam.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public upgrade mutation path is enabled by this AR.
